content: More than 30 researchers and developers from more than 5 institutions have contributed code to the jiant project. jiant's maintainers welcome pull requests that introduce new tasks or sentence encoder components, and pull request are actively reviewed. The jiant repository's continuous integration system requires that all pull requests pass unit and integration tests and meet Black code formatting requirements.
